title: Deterministic REVIEW band [t_accept,t_reject) on the Q1 integer score: review<->error frontier under LOCO
protocol: leave-one-clip-out over 7 clips; per-fold thresholds from training clips only (quantiles p01/p05/p10/p25 mirrored for high-is-bad, Q=4 integers); operating point chosen on training clips only (false-reject budget 5% on training-good); metrics pooled on held-out windows; clip-bootstrap 95% CI (B=2000, seed=0)
decision_rule: REJECT if a QUALITY rule crosses its extreme threshold (index 0) or score >= t_reject; ACCEPT if score < t_accept (and margin_q >= m_min for axis 2); REVIEW otherwise

feature_source_sensitivity.note: gold.npz G_* is float32; per-feature comparison against the Q1 float64 source shows full.temp_b0/b1/b2 differ by up to 0.156 and all other features by <=3e-6. Because LOCO re-derives thresholds from the same source as the values, the integer out-of-fold scores are identical, so the BRIEF gold name map is decision-equivalent for this rule table.

feature_source_note: q1 = caches/gpu/features.json `full` (float64) + caches/perpixel/physics_feats.npz `phys`; the exact Q1/Q4 feature space the frozen thresholds were derived in. gold (BRIEF name map, gold.npz G_* float32) is a sensitivity variant: full.temp_b0/b1/b2 differ from the q1 source by up to 0.156 (all other features ~1e-8).

metric_definitions.ba_decided: 0.5 * ( P(REJECT | bad, decided) + P(ACCEPT | good, decided) ) -- balanced accuracy restricted to the decided windows (Q1/Q4 `balacc_decided_only` convention, verified to reproduce 0.808)
metric_definitions.fr_good: P(REJECT | good) over ALL good windows (review counted as not-rejected)
metric_definitions.fa_bad: P(ACCEPT | bad) over ALL bad windows (review counted as not-accepted)

best_operating_point.constraint: training-good false-reject <= 5% per fold (protocol-faithful, Q1 meaning)

best_operating_point_empirical_fr5.constraint: OBSERVED held-out false-reject <= 5% (empirical; chosen on test metrics, reported for the frontier, not a deployable protocol)

inner_selected_operating_point_train_onl.selection: per fold, maximise TRAINING balanced accuracy on decided windows over t_accept with the pre-registered tau=0.05 training-good FR budget; no test label used

inner_selected_operating_point_tau_swept.selection: per fold, maximise TRAINING balanced accuracy on decided windows over (t_accept, tau); tau in [0.0, 0.01, 0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2]; no test label used

inner_selected_operating_point_tau_and_m.selection: per fold, maximise TRAINING balanced accuracy on decided windows over (t_accept, tau, m_min) with the scale-free margin axis (half-gap units); no test label used

inner_selected_operating_point_tau_and_c.selection: per fold, maximise TRAINING balanced accuracy on decided windows over (t_accept, tau, m_min) with the crossed-threshold margin axis; no test label used

ablation_without_quality_override.note: frozen Q1 semantics always hard-reject a QUALITY rule crossing its extreme (index 0) threshold; this ablation removes that override and keeps only the integer band, so hard-fired low-score windows can fall into ACCEPT/REVIEW.

paired_bootstrap_deltas.note: paired clip-bootstrap: the same resampled windows are scored by both decision rules; P(delta>0) is the share of resamples in which the new point has the higher BA. CIs are wide because there are only 7 clips and the decided subset is 33-48% of 150 windows.

baseline_reproduced.point: t_accept=1, per-fold t_reject from 5% training-good FR budget
baseline_reproduced.matches: Q4.01 pure_rules: review_share 0.60, balacc_decided_only 0.808, auroc 0.8222 -> exact reproduction

best_under_protocol_fr_budget_5pct.note: this row is the best point of the swept frontier; it is selected on the held-out metrics and is therefore an upper bound, not a deployable choice

best_deployable.point: inner-selected (t_accept, tau) per fold on TRAINING clips only, ranking = training BA on decided windows

frontier_mechanics.t_accept_edge: moving t_accept changes only the ACCEPT/REVIEW split; the REJECT set (quality hard fires + score>=t_reject) is untouched, so fr_good/fa_bad are constant along that family and only the decided subset changes
frontier_mechanics.t_reject_edge: moving t_reject (or the training budget tau) trades REJECT<->REVIEW: a stricter tau shrinks the reject set, lowers the observed false-reject rate on good windows and moves the hard cases into REVIEW instead of rejecting them

verdict.axis2: no sharpening: the scale-free half-gap margin is 0 for all 150 windows (m_min>=1 cannot ACCEPT anything) and the raw margin lattice is flat or worse (delta BA <= +0.0007 at a HIGHER review rate). See axis2_margin_review.

axis2_margin_review.description: margin = distance of the quantised value to the nearest of the 64 Q=4 thresholds. ACCEPT requires score < t_accept AND margin >= m_min, otherwise REVIEW (REJECT unchanged). m_min=0 reproduces the 2-axis band.

crossed.description: margin = Q=4 integer distance to the nearest CROSSED threshold (1e9 when nothing fires); ACCEPT requires score < t_accept and margin_crossed >= m_min.
